enum_name: # IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE: a new enum of batch D1 (PR #53 round 94)

comment: Not counting: the timer is held at the idle shutdown period, the warning lamp request and the overridden / override successful flags are cleared and output 30 is switched off (unless a client overrides it); leaves to COUNT when idle_shutdown_reset_flag is 0. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x00. (new enum, size 2, type of idle_shutdown_state) (PR #53 round 94)

The idle shutdown timer counts down (0.1 s per pass): to RESET on the reset flag, to DELAY when the temperature option and the override successful flag are set, to WARNING when the timer is at or below the warning period. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x40 (SPN 590 idle shutdown timer state active). (PR #53 round 94)

Shutdown approaching: sets the warning lamp request ISWRRQ and counts passes; to OVERRIDE when the override is enabled and successful, to RESET on the reset from warning flag, to SHUTDOWN after the warning period. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x44 (timer state active + SPN 594 driver alert mode active). (PR #53 round 94)

A 600-pass (60 s) delay before the override, entered from COUNT with the temperature option: to RESET on the reset flag, to OVERRIDE when the delay timer reaches 0. PGN 65252 byte 1 is left unchanged. No J90350.00 e2m text names this state; the name is the code's delay timer, and the later CHR_B2 e2m labels value 3 DELAY. (PR #53 round 94)

Idle shutdown overridden: the timer is reloaded, the warning request cleared, ISOD (overridden until the vehicle moves) and the override lamp request ISODRQ set; to RESET on the reset from override flag. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x10 (SPN 592 idle shutdown timer override active). (PR #53 round 94)

The idle shutdown has shut the engine down: on entry the warning request is cleared, the engine shutdown command SHSS set and output 30 switched on; to RESET when engine_state is CRANKING. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x01 (SPN 593 idle shutdown has shut down engine). (PR #53 round 94)
